∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (seed : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (leaf : Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitSeed record facts seed = Except.error (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal.lawDenied leaf) → ∃ before after, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts Option.none seed = Option.some (before, after) ∧ record.seedLaw.subterm leaf.path = Option.some leaf.clause ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval leaf.clause before after = Bool.false

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (seed : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitSeed record facts seed = Except.ok () ↔ (∃ before after, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts Option.none seed = Option.some (before, after) ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval record.seedLaw before after = Bool.true) ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt record.stateType seed = Bool.true

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (c : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.LiveClass) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite (record.bump f c) facts old new = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (leaf : Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new = Except.error (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal.lawDenied leaf) → ∃ before after, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) ∧ record.effectiveLaw.subterm leaf.path = Option.some leaf.clause ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval leaf.clause before after = Bool.false

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new = Except.ok () ↔ (∃ before after, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval record.effectiveLaw before after = Bool.true) ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt record.stateType new = Bool.true

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (payer : Minidregg.Theory.CanonicalResourceKernel.AccountId) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite { id := record.id, pin := record.pin, stateType := record.stateType, schemaVersion := record.schemaVersion, law := record.law, packageLaws := record.packageLaws, upgrade := record.upgrade, continuity := record.continuity, payer := payer, live := record.live, rebirths := record.rebirths, phase := record.phase } facts old new = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new

∀ {record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord} {facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts} {old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data} {new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new = Except.ok () → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt record.stateType new = Bool.true

∀ (artifacts : List ℕ) (rest : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), new.get Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot = Option.some (-1) → Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf.of (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.all (Minidregg.Pred.objectivePin artifacts :: rest)) old new = Option.some { path := [0], clause := Minidregg.Pred.objectivePin artifacts, before := old.get Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot, after := Option.some (-1) }
∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (c : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.LiveClass), (record.bump f c).classOf = record.classOf

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (c : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.LiveClass), (c = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.LiveClass.pending → ∃ next deadline, record.phase = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePhase.draining next deadline) → ∀ (other : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.LiveClass), (record.bump f c).count other = if other = c then f (record.count other) else record.count other

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (c : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.LiveClass), (record.bump f c).pin = record.pin ∧ (record.bump f c).law = record.law ∧ (record.bump f c).stateType = record.stateType ∧ (record.bump f c).upgrade = record.upgrade ∧ (record.bump f c).payer = record.payer ∧ (record.bump f c).activePin = record.activePin
∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (c : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.LiveClass), (record.bump f c).packageLaws = record.packageLaws
∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (c : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.LiveClass), (record.bump f c).pin = record.pin
∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (c : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.LiveClass), (record.bump f c).pins = record.pins

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval record.effectiveLaw old new = Bool.true ↔ Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.objectivePin record.pins) old new = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.packageLaw record.packageLaws) old new = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval record.law old new = Bool.true

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord), record.phase = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePhase.steady → record.effectiveLaw = Minidregg.Pred.Pred.all [Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.pinClause record.pin, Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.packageLaw record.packageLaws, record.law]

∀ (law : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (leaf : Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.judgeLaw law facts old new = Except.error (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal.lawDenied leaf) → ∃ before after, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) ∧ law.subterm leaf.path = Option.some leaf.clause ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval leaf.clause before after = Bool.false

∀ (law : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.judgeLaw law facts old new = Except.ok () ↔ ∃ before after, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval law before after = Bool.true

∀ {record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord} {facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts} {old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data} {new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data}, record.judge facts old new = Except.ok () → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new = Except.ok ()

∀ {record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord} {next : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Pending} {deadline : ℕ}, record.phase = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePhase.draining next deadline → ∀ {facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts} {old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data} {new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data}, record.judge facts old new = Except.ok () → next.migration = Option.none ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite (record.successor next) (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.migrateFacts facts.target next) (Option.some new) new = Except.ok ()

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (payer : Minidregg.Theory.CanonicalResourceKernel.AccountId) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), { id := record.id, pin := record.pin, stateType := record.stateType, schemaVersion := record.schemaVersion, law := record.law, packageLaws := record.packageLaws, upgrade := record.upgrade, continuity := record.continuity, payer := payer, live := record.live, rebirths := record.rebirths, phase := record.phase }.judge facts old new = record.judge facts old new

∀ {record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord}, record.phase = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePhase.steady → ∀ (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), record.judge facts old new = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new

∀ (pins : List ℕ) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (artifact : ℕ), facts.artifact = Option.some artifact → artifact ∈ pins → ∀ (before after : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.objectivePin pins) before after = Bool.true

∀ (authority authority' : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (floors floors' : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred), (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePolicy.governed authority floors).permits (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.UpgradePolicy.governed authority' floors') = Bool.true → (∀ floor ∈ floors, floor ∈ floors') ∧ ∀ (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval authority' old new = Bool.true → Minidregg.Pred.eval authority old new = Bool.true

∀ (pin : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), facts.artifact = Option.some pin.value → ∀ (before after : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.pinClause pin) before after = Bool.true

Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.leafOf (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts Option.none) Option.none (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 1)) = Option.some { path := [0], clause := Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.pinClause { value := 7 }, before := Option.some (-1), after := Option.some (-1) } ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.leafOf (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts (Option.some 8)) Option.none (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 1)) = Option.some { path := [0], clause := Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.pinClause { value := 7 }, before := Option.some 8, after := Option.some 8 } ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.accepted (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts (Option.some 7)) Option.none (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 1)) = Bool.true

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (pin activity : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (c : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.LiveClass), (record.release pin activity).count c = if c = record.classOf pin activity then record.count c - 1 else record.count c

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (pin activity : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (c : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.LiveClass), (record.retain pin activity).count c = if c = record.classOf pin activity then record.count c + 1 else record.count c

Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.accepted (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitSeed Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts Option.none) (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 1)) = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.accepted (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts Option.none) Option.none (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 1)) = Bool.false ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.accepted (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitSeed Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethSeedRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts Option.none) (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 5)) = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.leafOf (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitSeed Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethSeedRecord (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.teethFacts Option.none) (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.natural 6)) = Option.some { path := [1], clause := Minidregg.Pred.Pred.eq "state" 5, before := Option.none, after := Option.some 6 }

∀ (authority authority' : Minidregg.Pred.Pred), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.strengthens authority authority' = Bool.true → ∀ (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval authority' old new = Bool.true → Minidregg.Pred.eval authority old new = Bool.true

∀ {law : Except Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal Unit} {type : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendTypes.Ty} {new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data}, (match law with | Except.error reason => Except.error reason | Except.ok PUnit.unit => if Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt type new = Bool.true then Except.ok () else Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal.illTyped) = Except.ok () ↔ law = Except.ok () ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt type new = Bool.true

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), facts.artifact = Option.none → ∀ (before after : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new = Except.error (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.WriteRefusal.lawDenied { path := [0], clause := Minidregg.Pred.objectivePin record.pins, before := before.get Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot, after := Option.some (-1) })

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), facts.artifact = Option.none → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new ≠ Except.ok ()

∀ (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (before after : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) → before.get Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot = Option.some facts.artifactValue ∧ after.get Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot = Option.some facts.artifactValue

∀ (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (before after : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) → ∃ b a, before = { slots := facts.slots ++ b } ∧ after = { slots := facts.slots ++ a }
